headline: European Natural Gas Prices Reach €100 per MWh Amid Middle East Conflict
summary: European natural gas benchmark prices rose to 100 euros per megawatt-hour for the first time since 2022. Escalating Middle East war concerns and winter reserve replenishment efforts drove the surge.
why: Natural gas prices directly impact European electricity costs, industrial sector profitability, and regional inflation dynamics.

impacts.name: European Natural Gas
impacts.why: Middle East war fears and winter gas storage demand drove European natural gas benchmark prices higher.

why_moved: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East raised supply disruption fears ahead of the European winter heating season.
